# Pillar & Frame

> A story-led film studio in Ohio for founder-led service businesses. The Foundation is the core offer: one filming day, your Google Business Profile live inside a month, and every word, photo, and video written, shot, and installed for you over 90 days. The Engine is the optional monthly retainer that keeps it running after.

## Services
- The Foundation (core offer, one-time $5,000): one filming day, then a staged 90-day delivery: the Messaging Playbook in week two, the Google Business Profile live by day 30, and the full library installed by day 90. Not handed over. https://pillarandframe.com/
- The Engine (optional retainer after The Foundation, $2,500/mo): after The Foundation, we film you once a month and turn it into a month of videos, posts, captions, and graphics in your voice, with coaching built in. https://pillarandframe.com/engine

## Proof
- Case studies: https://pillarandframe.com/work (Frontier Technologies, Memorial Health)

## Book
